description: This PHP class 'DateTimeHelperService' provides various utility methods for handling date and time operations such as formatting, comparison, range generation, timezone handling, and week boundary calculations within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DateTimeHelperService
classes.description: Provides utility methods for formatting, comparing, and manipulating date/time objects, including timezone adjustments and week boundary calculations.

methods.name: getDateFormatter
methods.description: Returns an instance of LocalizedDateFormatter, creating one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToYmd
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object to a 'Y-m-d' string; returns null if input is null.

methods.name: formatDateTimeToTimeString
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object to a time string ('H:i' or 'H:i:s'); returns null if input is null.

methods.name: convertSecondsToTimeString
methods.description: Converts seconds into a time string ('H:i' or 'H:i:s').

methods.name: isDatesEqual
methods.description: Checks if two DateTime objects represent the same calendar date, optionally accepting nulls.

methods.name: dateDiffInHours
methods.description: Computes difference in hours between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: dateRange
methods.description: Generates an array of DateTime objects between two dates using a specified duration.

methods.name: getNow
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime, optionally in a specified timezone.

methods.name: getNowInUTC
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime in UTC timezone.

methods.name: getTimezoneByTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Creates a DateTimeZone object based on a float offset from UTC.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string, either using system config or default format.

methods.name: getWeekBoundaryForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates the start and end dates of the week for a given date and week start index.
